title: Ur-Nashet, the last night
notes: 800 years early, in a city that no longer exists. The player performs the founding crime before knowing it is one.

title: The Unstained Seat
notes: sect_vashti's own notes: 'no talk conversations available on their seat map' -- combat only, no dialogue resolution, grounded directly in that line. Seat is 'Vashti, in the Ashland' per sects.sect_vashti.seat.

title: Re-Made Clean
notes: sect_vashti's doctrine: 'sacraments from complicit hands are void; the veneration must be re-made clean' -- a re-consecration under threat, hence a defend shape.

title: The Vetch Reunion
notes: sect_court's own notes: 'grows the Grand Inquisitor; home-front thread, ambushes at reunion' -- taken directly. Vetch is sect_court's alternate seat name.

title: The Drowned March
notes: Chapter title is sect_march's own seat name verbatim ('the Drowned March'). Doctrine notes: 'new scripture is still arriving, dictated, in progress -- chapters can be added between the player's Act 2 visits' and 'Prophecy NPCs convert green levies' -- the latter reuses the same conversion mechanic already flagged as unmodeled at map_a02/map_b15, not a new system.

title: The Same Archive
notes: sect_march's notes: 'rebaptising the dead by name off the parish lists... puts the prophets and the crown's clerks in the same archive for opposite reasons' -- taken directly, a defend-the-archive shape.

title: The Toll League
notes: sect_road's own sovereign seat ('the Toll League'). Doctrine: 'redemption is a purchase word -- to redeem is to buy back' -- reuses the same 'purchase' objective_verb map_b15 already established for this sect, rather than inventing a different one for their second chapter.

title: The Ledger Comes Due
notes: Buildup chapter for the Enlightened One fork -- ties to ascension_signals (sig_forge_use, sig_defection_handling, etc.), the hidden telemetry that later decides end_sanctified vs. end_perverse. Doesn't resolve which way it tips; that's runtime state, not authored here.

title: Sanctification
notes: end_sanctified terminal (endings tab, trigger: hidden telemetry threshold MET). Per that row: 'NOT a boss fight against him. The party fights the deposed patrons of the Hundred Cities -- the full Lesser Key roster... as they resist being absorbed.' Mutually exclusive with ch_e32_perverse -- same slot (act 3, number 32), only one fires per playthrough.
teaches_system: the good ending still costs something

title: The Idol
notes: end_perverse terminal (endings tab, trigger: hidden telemetry threshold NOT met). Per that row: 'the party fights HIM directly. VISUAL CONVERGENCE WITH THE IDOL, deliberate.' Mutually exclusive with ch_e32_sanctified -- same slot, only one fires per playthrough.

title: The Capture
notes: end_hierophant's shared lead-up (endings tab): 'the defense scenario ends in capture, not a kill.' sect_id resolved to sect_march (RESOLVED 2026-09-23, see the_hierophant tab).

title: The Kaisareia Trial
notes: Deliberately NO MAP -- endings.end_hierophant is explicit that this is processed through the same systemic machine as everything else ('the same machine that produces deputies off the epithet ledger now processes the largest moral choice in the game, not a special cutscene outside the system'), not a battle. Forks into ch_h33_mercy or the ch_h34_war_* chapters depending on the player's sentence recommendation. sect_id resolved to sect_march, see ch_h31 and the_hierophant tab.

title: Subterfuge
notes: end_hierophant_mercy terminal: 'the movement goes underground and finishes what got interrupted -- A SECOND, LATER BATTLE... deliberately convergent iconography with end_perverse and the Idol.' sect_id resolved to sect_march, see ch_h31 and the_hierophant tab.

title: The War: First Front
notes: end_hierophant_execution terminal: 'not one climactic fight -- several chapters of costly, attritional maps against regions and sects that were allied or neutral an act ago, now fractured.' 'Several' isn't a specific count in that text -- 3 chapters (war1/2/3) is this pass's own invented number, not sourced. sect_id resolved to sect_march, see ch_h31 and the_hierophant tab.

title: The War: Second Front
notes: Second of the invented 3-chapter War arc -- see ch_h34_war1's note.
teaches_system: the front keeps moving, there's no fixed line to hold

title: The War: Reckoning
notes: Third and final of the invented 3-chapter War arc -- see ch_h34_war1's note. Closes the execution branch.
teaches_system: the cost lands on the world

title: The North Wind Winds

teaches_system: a saint who will not judge

title: His Lake
